newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail basis offers soften.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail basis offers soften.

text.p: Most rail basis offers for soymeal fell Thursday in response to softening demand from end-users in spot markets, dealers said.
"The demand is decent but it's not great," said one dealer from the southeast. "People are still going hand-to-mouth."
The markets in central Illinois were said to have a firmer undertone because a large crusher in the area is taking downtime for the remainder of August.
The National Oilseed Processors Association is expected to report a crush of 22.7 million to 24.1 million bushels, sources said.

One merchandiser who estimated near the low end of the range, said he felt the crush would fall below last week's at 23.549 million bushels because his plant was shipping meal to southeastern locations that are typically served by other crushers.
